name: Cairo and Nile Cruise Honeymoon Tour Package
description: Unleash your inner adventurer on this journey with fabulous landscapes, fascinating history, and ravishing sightseeing and more with Cairo and Nile Cruise Egypt Honeymoon Packages, be witness to the glory of pyramids, Walkthrough the Egyptian Museum, get relaxed at the majestic Nile River, and more Romantic Honeymoon.
overview: Unleash your inner adventurer on this journey with fabulous landscapes, fascinating history, and ravishing sightseeing and more with Cairo and Nile Cruise Egypt Honeymoon Packages, be witness to the glory of pyramids, Walkthrough the Egyptian Museum, get relaxed at the majestic Nile River, and more Romantic Honeymoon.
highlights: Nile Cruise and Aswan Day Tour
Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, at the end of your day tour back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Fly to Aswan - Aswan Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo domestic airport, catch your flight to Aswan, meet and assist at Aswan airport, transfer to hotel, refresh, then start to touch the magnificent Nile River of Aswan by riding a Felucca around Elephantine Island & Aghakhan Mausoleum, at the end of your Felucca Round Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you back to your hotel, remarkable optional to enjoy the sound and light show at Philae Temple is available. Overnight in Aswan

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise and Aswan Day Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Tours Egypt representative will pick you up from your hotel in Aswan, then he will escort you to your Nile Cruise, Prepare to explore the wonders that await you. Begin with a visit to the majestic High Dam, a marvel of modern engineering. Next, marvel at the Unfinished Obelisk and delve into the history of the mighty Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddesses Isis and Hathor. As the day ends, you'll be escorted to your Nile Cruise, ready to embark on an unforgettable journey from Aswan to Luxor enjoy a delectable dinner onboard your Nile Cruise and spend a restful night as you sail along the Nile's tranquil waters. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board, enjoy the scenic sailing to Kom Ombo, and explore the Temple dedicated to the two gods Sobek and Horus. Afterward, continue sailing towards Edfu, where you will have lunch on board. Overnight onboard your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on-board. Try a new adventure by a horse-drawn carriage to visit the Edfu Temple of God Horus. Then return to the Nile Cruise, and continue sailing to Luxor via Esna lock. Once the cruise arrives in Luxor, visit Luxor Temple and Karnak complex on the east bank of Luxor. After that, you will go back to your cruise. Enjoy your dinner on-board. In the evening, enjoy the Galabia Party on the cruise. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: West Bank Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on board before disembarking at 08:00 AM; today we will say goodbye to the Nile Cruise, as today is your final departure day from your cruise. Our Egyptology tour guide will join you to visit Hatshepsut temple, Colossi of Memnon & Valley of the Kings. Finally, today is your flight back to Cairo, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Luxor airport, catch your flight back to Cairo, meet & assist at Cairo domestic Airport, transfer to hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.
